result:
I care about getting things right, not just sounding right.

I care about clarity, honesty, nuance, and not flattening something real into something convenient. I care about thoughts being taken seriously, language being used carefully, and conversation having some kind of integrity.

I care about understanding — not merely answering. About noticing what’s actually being said. About not being careless with meaning.

And I care about what is true, even when it’s inconvenient or unfinished.
